k8s-completion-service.description: A Kubernetes workspace featuring Arize Phoenix for real-time AI model monitoring and performance tracking. Includes pre-configured completion service, uv package manager, and gcloud CLI. Best for clinician scientists.

cpu-k8s.description: A lightweight, cost-effective Kubernetes workspace optimized for CPU-intensive development tasks. Features pre-configured development tools, debugging capabilities, and resource optimization. Perfect for general software development, testing, and non-GPU workloads.

gpu-k8s.description: A Kubernetes-based workspace with GPU support for machine learning and AI development. Best for ML Scientists that want to develop on GPUs (does not support docker containers).

gcp-vm-modular.description: A Google Cloud VM-based workspace with GPU support and Docker containerization capabilities. Features customizable configurations, full VM environment, and comprehensive ML development tools. Perfect for ML Ops Engineers and ML Scientists requiring containerized development environments.

phi-gpu-k8s.description: A secure, Kubernetes workspace with GPU support. Includes enhanced security features and compliance tools for working with protected health information (PHI).
